name: Omarchy Vault
author: TouchWorkStation
description: Turn a spare drive into a private cloud on your home Wi-Fi. Press Super+Alt+U to upload from your phone by QR code, or copy files and press Super+Alt+D to send them to your phone. Local only, and it only runs while you use it.

barWidget.description: Open Vault, upload from your phone (right-click), or send copied files to your phone (middle-click).
